ev.q: This report describes a case of fatal WNV encephalitis in an immunosuppressed patient
WNV serologic testing was conducted on all 10 associated donors.
One apheresis donor was positive for WNV IgM antibodies
Four of these recipients had since died
Nine donors had no evidence of WNV infection by WNV IgM enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay.
This report describes a case of fatal WNV encephalitis in an immunosuppressed patient
